views.definition:
SELECT id,
    title,
    description,
    activity_type,
    start_at,
    end_at,
    responsible_user,
    status,
    vehicle_id,
    created_by,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    enabled,
    date_range,
        CASE
            WHEN ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['completado'::text, 'cancelado'::text])) AND (now() > end_at)) THEN 'en_demora'::text
            ELSE status
        END AS status_effective
   FROM planning p;
